protocol.prediction_mode: saved replay; no refit or retuning
protocol.primary_training: Hanson positives and assumed negatives only
protocol.primary_scoring: Hanson only, before last n=1 onset; no verified negatives
protocol.within_shot_auroc: primary and broad Hanson masks, fixed score orientation; equal-shot mean/median over shots with both classes; per-shot class counts include excluded one-class shots
protocol.paired_within_shot_auroc: forest minus each continuous scalar, primary and broad masks; equal-shot mean of per-shot AUROCs over shared two-class Hanson shots; 95% basic paired shot-bootstrap intervals, seed 0
protocol.phase_controlled_auroc: primary Hanson slices; positive-negative pairs restricted to campaign x floor(elapsed_ms/100), bins [100*k,100*(k+1)); pair-count-weighted cell AUROC; omit cells with fewer than 5 slices or one class and missing time; 1000 campaign-stratified shot resamples, seed 0; individual percentile and forest-minus-scalar basic paired intervals
protocol.phase_bin_width_sensitivity: 50/100/200/400/800 ms and no time-bin control; primary Hanson mask, campaign control retained, same minimum cell size; point estimates only, no tuning or selection
protocol.primary_mask_mechanism: primary negatives end at last n=1 onset; final labelled slices are positive, giving increasing elapsed time nearly perfect within-shot ranking
protocol.broad_sensitivity: same predictions; post-last-onset and n=2-only negatives added
protocol.high_beta: beta_N >= 0.8 times each shot's whole-window p95 (evaluation only)
protocol.time_baseline: elapsed since first |Ip| >= 0.5 MA; fixed causal start proxy
protocol.alarm_tuning: threshold grid from primary negatives; alarm objective over full inner-OOF Hanson traces through last n=1/n=2 onset +100 ms; comparison shots never tune alarms
protocol.primary_alarm_scope: Hanson traces end at last n=1/n=2 onset +100 ms; comparison traces retain full span; physical state remains unassessed
protocol.full_trace_alarm_sensitivity: independently retune on full Hanson traces; same forest fits and inner folds
protocol.shot_categories: first considered alarm decides: Detected if it warns any n=1 target by 10-400 ms; Early if unexplained and >400 ms before a future target; otherwise Missed; n=2-only No target; comparison FP means alarm incidence, not verified stable-shot FPR
protocol.any_alarm_category_sensitivity: any target warning wins, otherwise any Early alarm, otherwise Missed; category sensitivity only, no refit or retuning; per-onset metrics retain all alarms
protocol.nnpu: excluded: outer-fold-informed development and unidentified U prior
protocol.rotation_claim: removed; no isolated rotation benefit claimed
protocol.interval_scope: shot sampling at fixed fitted OOF predictions; split sensitivity separate
protocol.multiplicity: exploratory intervals, unadjusted for multiple comparisons

protocol.name: leave-one-run-record-out
protocol.calendar_date_note: 20180314 and 20180314A share a date and remain separate; no calendar-day isolation is claimed
protocol.scope: Hanson only; all sibling shots of the held-out run excluded from training and tuning
protocol.interval_scope: 1000 shot resamples at fixed fitted run-held-out predictions; not a four-run population CI

split_sensitivity.range_scope: min/max point AUROC across five fixed-hyperparameter shot-fold splits, not a CI
split_sensitivity.paired_reference: fixed elapsed-time ranks from seed 0 (no fitting; scores identical for every split); pooled primary and two conditional masks

legacy.context: different machine, expert-reviewed stable shots, not comparable
legacy.validation: 106 training and 28 test shots; seven NSTX inputs; 5 ms slices, 100 ms forecast; separate slice cutoff 0.450 and hysteresis 0.36/0.71/60 ms

screen_audit.scope: binary screen calls on cached 10 ms Hanson slices, not comparison reference times

onset_physics.scope: all 48 merged Hanson n=1 onset points, by campaign
onset_physics.snapshot_scope: first cached 10 ms slice in [o-20 ms, o); separate from onset inputs
onset_physics.onset_scope: last EFIT sample at or before exact onset; age <= EFIT_MAX_AGE_MS; offline-held inputs
onset_physics.high_beta_coverage_scope: slices in [o-100 ms, o) with beta_N >= 0.8 times whole-window p95

labelled_slice_qmin.scope: Hanson primary 10 ms slices labelled 0 or 1; held offline qmin; fraction among all labelled slices, with missing values in denominator; finite-only fraction separate
